page_title: BOL 2-0 VER | Bologna v Verona 23/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+2' One of the players from Verona times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.

90' Thomas Henry (Verona) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Lukasz Skorupski shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
89' The ball is out of play and Bologna manage to earn a corner.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Michael Folorunsho trots off the pitch and is replaced by Darko Lazovic (Verona).
86' Verona can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
86' The statistic for corner kicks – 10:0.
85' The corner is swung in but Bologna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
83' The attendance is 24828.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Daniel Silva (Verona) will replace Ondrej Duda.
82' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Tijjani Noslin and he is replaced by Thomas Henry (Verona).
82' Substitution. Jesper Karlsson (Bologna) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Dan Ndoye walks off.
82' Here is a change. Remo Freuler is going off and Thiago Motta gives the last tactical orders to Oussama El Azzouzi (Bologna).
81' Michel Aebischer (Bologna) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Giovanni Fabbian.
79' Juan David Cabal (Verona) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
79' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Verona.
75' Stefan Posch goes off the pitch and Lorenzo De Silvestri (Bologna) comes on.
75' Thiago Motta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Charalampos Lykogiannis (Bologna) replacing Riccardo Orsolini.
75' Juan David Cabal (Verona) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Giacomo Camplone blows his whistle for an infringement.
74' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Verona was in an offside position.
72' A long-range effort by Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) after he received a good pass was well wide of the right post.
71' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
69' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
68' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bologna.
65' 2 - 0 What a hit! Remo Freuler (Bologna) shows good composure inside the box to fire a first-time shot into the top of the net. 2:0.
64' What an opportunity! Tijjani Noslin (Verona) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post!
61' Giacomo Camplone blows his whistle after Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
58' Marco Baroni prepares a substitution. Fabien Centonze is replaced by Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona).
58' Here comes a substitution. Karol Swiderski is given a rest as he is replaced by Stefan Mitrovic (Verona).
57' The percentage of ball possession is – 59:41.
56' Bologna are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
55' Bologna work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
53' Sam Beukema (Bologna) is furious with himself for wasting a glorious chance. He got to a rebound inside the 6-yard box, but his header went narrowly wide of the left post.
53' There's an opportunity for Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
52' Giacomo Camplone blows his whistle. Ondrej Duda (Verona) commits a foul after dangerous play.
50' A cross from Michael Folorunsho (Verona) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

47' Verona slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
46' The whistle blows and Giacomo Camplone starts the second half.
45+9' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+8' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) picks up the ball, dribbles to the edge of the penalty area and unleashes a brilliant shot to the bottom left corner, but is thwarted by a great save from Lorenzo Montipo.
45+6' Ondrej Duda (Verona) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
45+5' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
45+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Bologna comes to nothing.
45+4' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bologna, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45+3' Tomas Suslov (Verona) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
45+3' Dan Ndoye (Bologna) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
45' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
44' Michael Folorunsho (Verona) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
44' Giacomo Camplone blows for a foul after Victor Kristiansen (Bologna) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
42' The resulting set piece from Bologna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
41' Lukasz Skorupski steps in and intercepts a long pass from Giangiacomo Magnani (Verona).
39' Verona are ruled offside.
37' Fabien Centonze (Verona) crosses the ball forward but it is intercepted.
36' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) misses the left post by a whisker with a close-range rebound. What a chance that was!
35' Lewis Ferguson (Bologna) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
33' Tijjani Noslin (Verona) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
32' Wonderful movement by Bologna. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
30' Referee Giacomo Camplone points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Bologna players.
29' The goal for Bologna is subject to a VAR review by the referee! He's obviously unsure or he received a message.
27' 1 - 0 Goal! Giovanni Fabbian (Bologna) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:0.
27' Bologna force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
26' Bologna failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
26' Bologna take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
24' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Lewis Ferguson (Bologna), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
23' Ondrej Duda (Verona) brings an opponent down and Giacomo Camplone interrupts the game.
22' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
21' Suat Serdar (Verona) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Giacomo Camplone blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Yellow card. Remo Freuler (Bologna) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

19' Tomas Suslov (Verona) wastes a great scoring opportunity! He latches on to a precise pass and fires a decent first-time shot towards the top of the net from a promising distance, but Lukasz Skorupski denies him.
18' Jhon Lucumi (Bologna) brings his opponent down. Giacomo Camplone has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Stefan Posch (Bologna) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
13' Joshua Zirkzee (Bologna) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
10' Looks like we are going to have a change of refs with Giacomo Camplone taking over.
7' The ref seems to have picked up an injury and there’s going to be a break in play whilst he receives some attention.

4' A great solo effort from Karol Swiderski (Verona) and he attempts to surprise the goalkeeper with a long-range shot low towards the middle of the goal. Lukasz Skorupski has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.

3' Juan David Cabal (Verona) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Rosario Abisso blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
2' Riccardo Orsolini (Bologna) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' Verona seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Verona will take the kick-off.
Rosario Abisso is introduced as the referee for today's match.
